Index: /tmp/opencode/kbtest.sh
===================================================================
--- /tmp/opencode/kbtest.sh
+++ /tmp/opencode/kbtest.sh
@@ -1,30 +1,24 @@
 #!/bin/bash
-# Замер: какие байты доходят до pty от Ctrl+буква в US vs RU (Alacritty, X11)
-OUT=/tmp/opencode/keytest.out
-rm -f "$OUT"
-pre=$(xdotool search --class keytest 2>/dev/null | sort)
-nohup alacritty --class keytest -T keytest -e sh -c 'stty -icanon -isig -echo min 0; timeout 14 cat -v' >"$OUT" 2>/dev/null &
-sleep 3
-post=$(xdotool search --class keytest 2>/dev/null | sort)
-wid=$(comm -13 <(echo "$pre") <(echo "$post") | head -1)
-[ -z "$wid" ] && { echo "NO_WINDOW"; exit 1; }
-echo "wid=$wid"
-xdotool windowactivate --sync "$wid"; sleep 1
-
-echo "ШАГ1 us: ctrl+a ctrl+x"
-setxkbmap -layout us
-sleep 0.3
-xdotool key ctrl+a;  sleep 0.5   # ожидаем 0x01
-xdotool key ctrl+x;  sleep 0.5   # ожидаем 0x18
-
-echo "ШАГ2 ru active, шлём кириллические keysyms (XKB сам подберёт физ. клавишу A/X/N):"
-setxkbmap -layout ru; sleep 0.4
-cur=$(setxkbmap -query | awk '/layout/{print $2}')
-echo "layout_now=$cur"
-xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_de;  sleep 0.5   # физ.А+ctrl при RU
-xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_che; sleep 0.5   # физ.X+ctrl при RU
-xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_te;  sleep 0.5   # физ.N+ctrl при RU
-xdotool key cyrillic_ef;       sleep 0.5   # plain RU-ф: ожидаем UTF-8 d1 84
-xdotool windowkill "$wid" 2>/dev/null
-echo "=== hexdump ==="
-xxd "$OUT" 2>/dev/null | head -14
+OUT=/tmp/opencode/keytest.out; rm -f "$OUT"
+setsid nohup alacritty --class keytest -T KEYTESTX -e sh -c 'stty -icanon -isig -echo min 0; timeout 20 cat -v' >"$OUT" 2>/tmp/opencode/keytest.err &
+wid=""
+for i in $(seq 1 20); do
+  wid=$(xdotool search --name KEYTESTX 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
+  [ -n "$wid" ] && break
+  sleep 0.5
+done
+echo "wid=$wid pgrep=$(pgrep -fa 'KEYTESTX|class keytest' | grep -c alacritty)"
+[ -z "$wid" ] && { cat /tmp/opencode/keytest.err; exit 1; }
+xdotool windowactivate --sync "$wid"; sleep 0.7
+setxkbmap -layout us; sleep 0.3
+xdotool key ctrl+a;  sleep 0.4
+xdotool key ctrl+x;  sleep 0.4
+setxkbmap -layout ru; sleep 0.3
+xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_de;  sleep 0.4
+xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_che; sleep 0.4
+xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_te;  sleep 0.4
+xdotool key cyrillic_ef;       sleep 0.4
+setxkbmap -layout us,ru -option grp:alt_shift_toggle
+sleep 0.3; xdotool windowkill "$wid" 2>/dev/null
+echo "=== hexdump (эталон: 01,18 | ?? ?? ??,d184) ==="
+xxd "$OUT"
